description: This file contains generated C# source code for the Orleans project, including extension methods, classes, interfaces, and enums related to Orleans hosting, clustering, messaging, serialization, and internal runtime components. It provides APIs for configuring Orleans clients and servers, managing grain lifecycle and placement, messaging protocols, and system metrics.
